push.title: L 2-3 vs SÖMBRA FC | You: 8.7
push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.7. Not flashy, just useful, and useful wins matches.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at SÖMBRA FC's goal. Keep finding those looks; the goals will follow.
+ 2 key passes. That's the kind of creativity that keeps opposing coaches up at night.
+ That connection with BellyTb1 is the real deal. Find 'em early and often.
+ Passes attempted 46, up from your usual 33. That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ 0.7 better than usual. That's a staircase, and you're climbing it.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Game plan: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide. We'll get there together.
- 72% passing (33 of 46, down from your usual 79%). Write this down: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough. You've got this.
- You and BellyTb1 can fix shot selection as a duo: cut it back to each other.
- 1 tackle won: -0.1. Room to grow.
- Your 3rd straight loss. I'm not pointing fingers. I'm pointing at the mirror, mine included.

Drill: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Before you go, PhogsToffees: Be curious about your game, not cruel to it.

Go easy on yourself tonight. Go hard at it tomorrow. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-3 vs SÖMBRA FC | You: 8.5
push.body:
Good stuff, BellyTb1. An 8.5 against SÖMBRA FC. Not fireworks, but a nice warm campfire.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at SÖMBRA FC's goal. You kept knocking on that door like a Girl Scout with a quota.
+ 1 assist. Every key pass is a love letter to a teammate.
+ You and PhogsToffees were on the same wavelength, like two radios tuned to the good station.
+ 0.7 above your usual rating. That's growth, and growth is the whole point.
+ Better pass accuracy than any of their humans (82% vs their best 81%). That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.

THE BAD
- 1 of 6 shots on target. Low-hanging fruit: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
- PhogsToffees had the same shot selection gremlin. Squash it together: cut it back to each other.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. That's where the match slipped.
- 1 tackle won cost 0.1. Not the end of the world.
- Your 3rd straight loss. Nobody carries that alone. We carry it as a team.

Training ground: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

Between you and me, BellyTb1: The best time to plant a tree was yesterday. The second best is next match.

Rome wasn't built in a day, but they were laying bricks every hour. - Coach Lasso
